name: Subtitle scrub
summary: Removes advert and credit lines from text subtitles
whatItDoes: Takes every text subtitle track out of the file, deletes the cues that match the patterns below — release-group credits, site adverts, "synced and corrected by" lines — and puts the cleaned tracks back where they were, with the same language and flags.
howItWorks: Each SRT or mov_text track is extracted with ffmpeg, cleaned line by line, renumbered, and muxed back in its original position. Every other stream is copied untouched. The finished file is tagged plexfixer_scrubbed so a rule can tell it has been done.
ifDisabled: Flags bound to this script are reported but not fixed.

patterns.label: Remove cues matching
patterns.help: Regular expressions, matched without regard to case, against each cue's text.

codecs.label: Track formats to clean
codecs.help: Styled ASS/SSA tracks are left alone by default: cleaning them goes through SRT and loses the styling.
